name: CoA Custom races: Cannibalize, Make Camp and Bone Gnaw eat a corpse like Cannibalize
contract: The package racials Cannibalize 14000512 (race 51), Make Camp 14000742 (Vulpera, 74) and Bone Gnaw 14000832 (Gnoll, 83) copy Cannibalize 20577: effect 0 is a dummy, and their tooltip reads 'regenerates $20578s1% of total health every $20578t1 sec for $20578d. Only works on Humanoid or Undead corpses within $a1 yds.'

The channel, its bar and the heal are spell 20578, cast by spell_gen_cannibalize (CoA Custom 1.6, 10_cannibalize_1.6.sql). With the script a cast without a corpse within 5 yd is refused with SPELL_FAILED_NO_EDIBLE_CORPSES (141) and a cast beside an enemy Humanoid corpse starts 20578; without it every cast succeeds and does nothing.
All three races are Horde; the Human who dies beside them is the Alliance corpse. Native cast results and auras are observed.
